title: Lie Detector (Determined That Was a Lie)
blurb: 'The lie detector determined... that was a lie.' The daytime-TV verdict that became the internet's favorite way to expose anyone. The pause before the ruling is everything — hope builds, then justice lands. Play it after excuses, alibis, and 'I'm five minutes away.' Court is always in session and the polygraph never misses.
origin: The lie-detector verdict format from daytime talk shows (Maury), meme-ified.
